source:
PvZ Fusion 4.0.5 Update

Happy National Day!

1. Snowy Night updates
Completed the 阿尔法日记 content and adjusted [Snowy Night: Day 6].

2. New plants
Basic Fusions: Snow Threepeater, Flytrapper, Mandiboulder
Odyssey Fusion: Melancholy Commando

3. New skins
Tidebreaker Wither-pult
Moon Festival Selene Cabbage
Complete the corresponding skin challenges to unlock them.

4. Level updates
Magic Plantbrush: Draw the plant you want as accurately as you can.
The large-map tower defense mode returns.
Super Level Editor: Added many new features and a user guide.

5. Balance changes
Odyssey Cursed Mode: Shop modifier prices now increase gradually. Buying expensive modifiers increases prices further.
Reduced 究极火炬's damage bonus to 浴火豌豆.
Pyroboros Pot: Cherryshooter's attack speed bonus is now fixed at 10%, without requiring the [真正的樱桃炸弹] modifier.

6. Other improvements
Significantly reduced the game's file size.

7. Fixed known bugs and improved the gameplay experience.
english:
PvZ Fusion 4.0.5 Update

Happy National Day!

1. Snowy Night updates
Completed Alpha's diary and adjusted [Snowy Night: Day 6].

2. New plants
Basic Fusions: Snow Threepeater, Flytrapper, Mandiboulder
Odyssey Fusion: Melancholy Commando

3. New skins
Tidebreaker Wither-pult
Moon Festival Selene Cabbage
Complete the corresponding skin challenges to unlock them.

4. Level updates
Magic Plantbrush: Draw the plant you want as accurately as you can.
The large-map tower defense mode returns.
Super Level Editor: Added many new features and a user guide.

5. Balance changes
Odyssey Cursed Mode: Shop modifier prices now increase gradually. Buying expensive modifiers increases prices further.
Reduced the damage bonus that Infernal Squashwood and Infernal Sparkwood give to Phoenix Peas.
Pyroboros Pot: Cherryshooter's attack speed bonus is now fixed at 10%, without requiring the [Cherry on Top] modifier.

6. Other improvements
Significantly reduced the game's file size.

7. Fixed known bugs and improved the gameplay experience.

terms.basis: Descriptive English, not a new title. Alpha spelling is established in PC translation_strings.json. Official Chinese 4.0.5 announcement places this diary in Snowy Night; PC changelog calls the mode Memory - Snowy Night.

terms.source: 究极火炬 / 浴火豌豆
terms.english: Infernal Squashwood and Infernal Sparkwood / Phoenix Peas
terms.basis: Paired PC Dumps/LawnStrings.json and Localization/English/Almanac/LawnStringsTranslate.json, seedType 902 and 948. 902 Chinese explicitly lists Phoenix pea damage x2; English names Phoenix Pea. 948 is its subspecies and inherits its treatment of other projectiles. Source uses the abbreviated family reference, not a separate plant name. Also tips_fs level1319 and seedType 919/999 establish Phoenix pea terminology. No numeric balance values imported from potentially stale descriptions.

Paired Dumps/travel_buffs.json and Localization/English/Strings/travel_buffs.json, advancedBuffs/1013. PC card name is Cherry on Top; description calls it True Cherry Bomb. Current Android runtime renders that same name.

scope: Only the existing official Android 4.0.5 announcement text. Preserve current content and layout, do not copy PC-only disclaimers or mixed-version changelog wholesale.
